title: Cross-Surface Authority Spine v1 — Canonical

surface_rules.frontend_cockpit_rule: Cockpit/frontend is a projection and intent surface, not authority. It renders backend-provided projections and submits intent envelopes. It must never evaluate policy, authorize mutations, mint approval receipts, or override governance decisions.
surface_rules.cli_rule: CLI and scripts are not exempt from governance. Every mutating command must default to dry-run or require explicit --execute with approval receipt. Exit codes must be stable. No script must directly call GitHub mutation APIs without Trust Spine prerequisites satisfied.
surface_rules.websocket_rule: WebSocket server is a projection transport, not an authority surface. Every intent must be independently validated by backend governance. Frontend origin verification required. Rate limiting enforced.
surface_rules.static_docs_rule: Static docs are public projection surfaces. Every generated page must pass public/private split enforcement and content-light scan before deployment.

protocol_rules.mcp_rule: MCP is read-only/evidence-first until descriptor integrity enforcement, roots workspace boundary enforcement, content-light output scanning, and per-user authorization are integrated and tested. MCP mutation tools (tier 4-5) are FORBIDDEN until signed, time-bound, scope-bound approval receipts are cryptographically enforced server-side.
protocol_rules.acp_rule: ACP must converge with the IDE sidecar and share the same governance spine as cockpit and CLI. ACP edit proposals must produce patch_proposal artifacts in the same format as MCP. ACP terminal commands must use RuntimeSupervisor.
protocol_rules.a2a_rule: A2A is inter-agent delegation, not local tool calling. Every delegation must have explicit trust tier, scope boundary, budget, timeout, and evidence receipt. Agent Cards must be content-light, signed or hash-pinned, and diffed on change.
protocol_rules.ssh_rule: SSH is absent and must stay absent until the SSH doctrine is fully implemented. SSH must never become an ungoverned remote shell for agents.

hosted_team_rule: Hosted/team mode is hybrid_local_first by default. JSONL remains the portable, inspectable, replayable source-of-truth. Postgres is the operational projection. Dual-write required.
github_trust_spine_rule: GitHub provider mutation must go through GitHub Provider Trust Spine v1 prerequisites before any remote write. Adapter must check trust spine state at code level.
postgres_source_of_truth_rule: PostgreSQL is the enterprise operational substrate. JSON/JSONL/CSV remain portable source-of-truth/evidence. DuckDB is disposable analytical/read-side. SQLite is forbidden.
telemetry_evidence_boundary_rule: Product telemetry: default-on, opt-out. Remote contribution: separately controlled. Local operational observability: mandatory. Enterprise audit/evidence: not disabled by telemetry opt-out. Raw prompts, completions, secrets, credentials, private files, raw diffs, Actions logs, secret fragments never in telemetry, remote contribution, static docs, or procurement packs.
common_envelope_requirement: Any surface causing local mutation, remote mutation, inter-agent delegation, admin configuration, hosted multi-tenant operation, or support/debug export must produce: policy decision, approval/evidence receipt where applicable, content-light classification, redaction scan result, and source artifact reference.
forbidden_bypasses: MCP mutation tools bypassing cockpit approval — BLOCKED
ACP messages bypassing CLI policy — BLOCKED
A2A delegated agent bypassing mission scope — BLOCKED
SSH remote command bypassing local supervisor — BLOCKED
Hosted API bypassing local evidence artifacts — BLOCKED
WebSocket frontend bypassing backend authorization — PARTIAL
GitHub provider mutation bypassing Trust Spine — BLOCKED
Telemetry export leaking raw content — PARTIAL
Debug packet leaking raw context — GAP
Static docs exposing private projections — PARTIAL
implementation_sequencing: P0: Cross-Surface Authority Spine v1 canonicalization
P0: Common envelope and schema spine adoption
P0: Frontend intent hardening and status indicators
P0: CLI command taxonomy unification and governance gating
P1: ACP transport server (behind IDE sidecar convergence)
P2: A2A Agent Card discovery and attestation
P2: SSH read-only diagnostics (after supervisor wrapping)
P2: Static docs public/private split enforcement
P3: Hosted team mode design with Postgres
P4: MCP mutation tools (only after approval receipts)
P4: A2A federation with remote agent trust tiers
do_not_overrun_guards: Do not implement SSH before authority spine and RuntimeSupervisor wrapping.
Do not implement MCP mutation tools before approval receipts and descriptor integrity.
Do not implement hosted API before tenant/RBAC and Postgres failure semantics.
Do not implement ACP transport before IDE sidecar convergence plan.
Do not implement A2A delegation before Agent Card attestation and trust tiers.
Do not allow CLI/scripts to mutate outside the same governance spine as cockpit.
Do not expose mutation MCP tools without signed, time-bound, scope-bound approval receipts enforced server-side.
Do not deploy static docs without public/private split enforcement and content-light scan.
Do not enable GitHub remote mutation before GitHub Trust Spine v1 prerequisites are satisfied.
Do not implement hosted mode with agent loop or private repo content on server by default.

content_light.redaction_note: This canonical doctrine contains no raw tokens, secrets, private repository contents, or source code.
